  := fun y => calc

  := fun y hy => calc

        exact Real.sin_x_le_one
      rw [abs_eq_self_of_nonneg (Real.sin_x_nonneg x)]
      exact key_sin_abs_le_1
    have key_sin_le_x : Real.sin x ≤ x
    := by

      := by
        apply abs_le
        exact key_sin_le_1
      rw [abs_eq_self_of_nonneg (Real.sin_x_nonneg x)]
      exact key_sin_abs_le_x
    exact key_sin_le_x
